body:
📦 **sirius-service-info `1b74d6c`** — feat(town): expose service menus and standard ingredient consumption

Return actual mounted menus from serveMenu regardless of prior service activity. Include food name/icon, full daily capacity/staff, normalized per100 consumption, class alternatives and yesterday attendance. Keep yesterday's used resources separate and queries read-only. Globe payload names class ingredients.

Verified real church before first day, active/shortage, cathedral scaling, restaurant, hospital, prayer, empty/filtered menus, farm unchanged and safe UI rendering; site_check passes. Browser proof uses actual townBld data and tbiUI/CSS in independent panel fixture. Game artifact integration follows with Blockside renderer update.

Refs TASK-1001

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
